note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CRO 8; A06b CRO 8; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 8 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Croatia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Croatia for 8 years immediately before the application. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of another citizenship, unless the person is stateless (a statement is sufficient if the other country does not allow renouncing citizenship, or places conditions which cannot be fulfiled) or is the spouse of a citizen (see A08). ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Croatia to a citizen. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to two citizens.; Person is born abroad to at least one Croatian citizen and birth is registered in Croatian consulate or registrar (in Croatia) before the age of 21, or person is older than 21 and within two years from the entry into force of the law (i.e. 1 January 2022) person submits application for registration as Croatian citizen (conditional on Interior ministry security checks). Or person is born abroad to a parent who is a citizen and another parent who is stateless or of unknown citizenship. ... No provision ... No provision
